title: 第181章 “你是在威胁我么？”
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

祝砚铮的语气很冷很淡。

就如同一句稀松平常的话，甚至连情绪都听不出来。

但就这一句话，原本还在叫嚣着的孟晚瞬间噤声，安静下来。

像是听错了。

孟晚微微歪头，眉头紧皱，看向祝砚铮的眼神带着茫然与不解。

“祝……先生，您这话是什么意思？”

“他们不会联系上宋瓷，之后也不会再出现在京市。”

祝砚铮语气淡冷，不轻不重地落在了孟晚的耳膜上。

不知何时，男人原本端坐的姿势改成了双腿交叠。

西裤裤脚露出半分男人漂亮的脚踝，孟晚的位置，甚至能够看到几分男人酒红色的手工皮鞋的鞋底。

今天的祝砚铮穿着十分郑重。

不仅戴了袖扣与领带，还戴了袖箍。

白色衬衫上，皮制的黑色袖箍透着银圈，微微泛着冷光。

他的上半身微微向后倚靠，整个身形便格外流畅舒适。

他的姿态放松冷矜，落在孟晚身上的眼神也冷凉无波，半分情绪都不显。

瞪大了眼睛，如同雕塑一般，孟晚愣在了原地。

怪不得……

怪不得昨天他们到了火车站，还打电话要她去接。

孟晚自然不会去，所以她将宋瓷的联系方式告知了宋瓷，让他们去骚扰宋瓷。

昨天他们拿到宋瓷的手机号码时，分明兴高采烈，说着要宋瓷来火车站迎接他们，还要求宋瓷去带他们住京市最好的酒店，说这是宋瓷欠他们的，是他们应得的。

可是，自今天早上，孟晚就再没得到他们的消息。

原本以为是因为缠上了宋瓷，不理她了。

怪不得。

怪不得……

所以，自始至终，她被纠缠了二十几年的，乡下的吸血鬼父母，祝砚铮居然连面都没让宋瓷见到吗？

凭什么……

到底凭什么！？

宋瓷她就应该、她就应该回到乡下去！

她本来就属于那里，是宋瓷夺走了她的人生！

现在一切回到正轨，难道她宋瓷不该回到那穷乡僻壤，不该让那对吸血鬼父母纠缠着，深陷泥沼再也走不出来吗！？

凭什么！？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhu Yanzheng's tone was very cold and indifferent.

It's like a common sentence, and you can't even hear the emotion.

But with this sentence, Meng Wan, who was still shouting, instantly fell silent and became quiet.

It seems like I heard it wrong.

Meng Wan tilted her head slightly, frowning, and looked at Zhu Yanzheng with confusion and confusion in her eyes.

"Wish... sir, what do you mean?"

"They will not contact Song Ci, and they will not appear in Beijing again."

Zhu Yanzheng's tone was cold and landed on Meng Wan's eardrums gently.

At some point, the man's original sitting posture changed to his legs crossed.

The legs of the trousers revealed half of the man's beautiful ankles. From Meng Wan's position, you could even see a bit of the soles of the man's burgundy handmade leather shoes.

Zhu Yanzheng was dressed very solemnly today.

Not only did he wear cufflinks and a tie, he also wore armbands.

On the white shirt, the black leather sleeve cuffs showed through the silver rings and shone slightly.

His upper body leaned back slightly, making his entire body shape particularly smooth and comfortable.

His posture was relaxed and cold, and the eyes that fell on Meng Wan were also cold and emotionless.

Meng Wan froze on the spot with her eyes widened like a sculpture.

No wonder...

No wonder they called her to pick them up when they arrived at the train station yesterday.

Meng Wan naturally wouldn't go, so she informed Song Ci of Song Ci's contact information and asked them to harass Song Ci.

When they got Song Ci's mobile phone number yesterday, they were clearly in high spirits. They asked Song Ci to come to the train station to meet them, and asked Song Ci to take them to stay in the best hotel in Beijing. They said that Song Ci owed them this and they deserved it.

However, Meng Wan had not heard from them since this morning.

I originally thought it was because I got entangled with Song Ci and ignored her.

No wonder.

No wonder...

So, from beginning to end, Zhu Yanzheng, the vampire parents in the countryside whom she had been pestering for more than twenty years, actually didn't even let Song Ci see her?

Why...

Why on earth!?

Song Ci should, she should go back to the countryside!

She originally belonged there, but Song Ci took away her life!

Now that everything is back on track, shouldn't she, Song Ci, return to that remote country and let those vampire parents entangle her, sinking into the quagmire and never getting out again??

Why!?
